title: This Ant's Jaws Snap Shut at Up to 145 Miles an Hour

scenes.text: This ant's jaws close at up to 145 miles per hour.
It's the trap-jaw ant. One snap takes just 0.13 milliseconds.
That's about 2,300 times faster than you blink.
The jaws accelerate at 100,000 times gravity.
It can even snap them against the ground and launch itself into the air.
A jaw strong enough to throw its own body. Watch that snap again.

description:
A trap-jaw ant closes its jaws at up to 145 miles per hour.
A single strike lasts 0.13 milliseconds, about 2,300 times faster than an eye blink.
It can launch itself into the air by snapping the jaws on the ground.
Would you want this ant on your lawn?
first_comment: Which tiny animal do you think is the most dangerous for its size?
